C.S.D, Special Branch.
REPORT
File No.
Date. December 9, 1939.
（印：CONFIDENTIAL DRAWER）
Subject. Suspected White Slave Trafficking at 32 Tsongchow Road.
Made by D.S. Mischenko Forwarded by D.S.I. O [签名]

（批：FILED）

Information has been received from a reliable
source to the effect that on November 1, 1939, a male
Russian named Tirinin has brought to Shanghai from Harbin
five Russian girls whose ages range from 17 to 22, under
a contract to sell the girls as prospective brides or
otherwise exploit them for lucrative purpose; the sum
of J.$2,500 was mentioned as the bargaining price for
each girl for sale. The party on their arrival, it was
reported, took up residence with a certain Mrs. Poluhov-
Morosenko somewhere on Tsongchow Road.

Discreet enquiries made by the undersigned,
D.S.I. Hiao Chung Chien and C.D.S.24, Hsu Zah Sing,
elicited the following information; -

A Mrs. Maria A.Polunov-Morosenko, alias Poluhoff-
Morosenko, Russian, 40 years old, together with her
paramour a male Russian named Tiredi and eight young
Russian girls are residing at House No.32, Flats 4 and 5
Tsongchow Road. It is reported that Tiredi and the
girls arrived in Shanghai from Harbin about a month ago
but they have actually removed to the present address
from Rue Ratard (number unknown) French Concession.
Observation of the premises in question show that the
girls are leaving the premises at all hours of the day
carrying a rattan basket in their hands and usually return
by 10 p.m.

Discreet questioning of Chinese servants brought
forward the information that the girls are at present
engaged either in prostitution or as masseuses.

（印：COMMISSIONER
10 DEC. 1939
(CRIME BRANCH)）

D.S.I. Konovaloff
Lorell.
[签名] 8/12.

据可靠消息来源称，1939年11月1日，一名名为 Tirinin 的俄国男子将五名年龄在17至22岁之间的俄国女孩从哈尔滨带至上海，并签订合同，意图将这些女孩作为准新娘出售，或以其他有利可图的方式加以剥削；据报道，每名待售女孩的议价为法币2,500元。据悉，该伙人抵达后，与某位 Poluhov-Morosenko 夫人一同居住在通州路某处。

经本报告人、副督察长 Hiao Chung Chien 及刑事侦探24号 Hsu Zah Sing 进行秘密查访，获悉以下情况：

一位名为 Maria A. Polunov-Morosenko（别名 Poluhoff-Morosenko）的俄国妇女，现年40岁，与其情夫、一名名为 Tiredi 的俄国男子以及八名年轻的俄国女孩，共同居住在通州路32号4室和5室。据报，Tiredi 和这些女孩约于一个月前从哈尔滨抵达上海，但他们实际上是从法租界拉达路（Rue Ratard，门牌号不详）搬至现址的。对有关处所的监视显示，这些女孩在白天任何时间都会手提藤篮离开住所，并通常于晚上10点前返回。

经对中国仆役进行秘密询问，得知这些女孩目前从事卖淫或按摩女工作。

（印：警务处长
1939年12月10日
（刑事组））

副督察长 Konovaloff
Lorell.
[签名] 12/8.

Mrs. Maria Polunova-Morosenko is known to have surreptitiously operated a brothel under the guise of a massage establishment which was formerly advertised in news-papers. In 1939 the premises ceased to be advertised as a massage establishment and it is strongly suspected that she was engaged in conducting prostitution and white slave trafficking.

Mrs. Maria Polunova-Morosenko was formerly the wife of Mr. K.A.Polunoff-Morosenko, Russian, former editor of "The World" in Harbin, publisher of "The Manchuria List" in Mukden and "The Far Eastern Advertising Agency" in Tientsin. During January 1929 he visited Shanghai for a short period and then returned to Tientsin. His present whereabouts are not known.

Mr. Polunov-Morosenko forms the subject of files No.D.2415 and D.8150 in connection with reported communistic activities.

There is nothing in Police records concerning Mrs. Maria Polunov-Morosenko.

Perusal of the shipping lists at this Section shows that a group of Russian girls whose names appear below, arrived in Shanghai from Dairen, together with a Russian female named Marchenko (possibly Morosenko) aged 40, on board the "Dairen Maru" on November 1, 1939:-

(1) Miss O.Kinstch        age 19,
(2) Miss H.Kinstch         "  16,
(3) Miss A.Kinstch         "  20,
(4) Miss Sosik             "  17,
(5) Miss A.Meronina        "  22,

Maria Polunova-Morosenko 夫人已知曾以按摩院为幌子，暗中经营妓院，该院此前曾在报纸上刊登广告。1939年，该处所不再以按摩院名义刊登广告，且有强烈嫌疑表明她从事卖淫及白人奴隶贩卖活动。

Maria Polunova-Morosenko 夫人原系 K.A. Polunoff-Morosenko 先生之妻。Polunoff-Morosenko 先生为俄国人，曾任哈尔滨《世界报》（The World）编辑、沈阳《满洲名录》（The Manchuria List）出版商以及天津《远东广告社》（The Far Eastern Advertising Agency）负责人。1929年1月，他曾短期访问上海，随后返回天津。其目前下落不明。

Polunov-Morosenko 先生因涉 reported communistic activities（报道中的共产主义活动），已成为档案号 D.2415 和 D.8150 的调查对象。

警方档案中并无关于 Maria Polunov-Morosenko 夫人的记录。

(1) O. Kinstch 小姐        年龄 19岁，
(2) H. Kinstch 小姐         "  16岁，
(3) A. Kinstch 小姐         "  20岁，
(4) Sosik 小姐             "  17岁，
